summary: Clearway on a multi-lane main road with no parking and no pull-off.
reasons: No verge or pull-off beside lane

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the south side, but a few houses sit 28 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb abuts the live lane of a divided road; nowhere to pull fully out.
drivers.traffic: Heavy, fast arterial traffic in both directions.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along it; clearway sign applies.

flags: Clearway sign 12 m from the kerb line
sun_shade: Open to sun; trees to the south give some afternoon shade.
